streaming.note: Advertised API; AR5/firmware support needs verification

velocity_and_position_feedforward.note: No verified joint velocity or position+velocity+effort command; never emulate using torque mode

servo_period.note: 50Hz ServoJ example; generic sendCommand documentation requires 1ms. Verify actual ServoJ firmware semantics

interpolation.note: Lookahead and gain configurable; active values/getter not identified

command_completion.note: Return is not proof of execution; queue semantics and applied timestamp unavailable

feedback_intervals_ms.note: Requested packet intervals, not measured native sensor sampling rates

device_timestamp_and_sequence.note: Not exposed. updateRobotState > 0 identifies received data only; identical values do not prove duplicate samples

torque.note: jointTorque() separately documents joint force sensor; do not assume streaming tau_m is identical without verification

motor_torque.value: motor_tau; units and output conversion unknown

temperature_voltage_derating.note: No motor/drive temperature, bus voltage or full derating flag fields found

fault_mode.note: Not a complete protection/ownership snapshot; no motion-control-mode getter identified

limits.note: J4 mapping, J6/J7 coupling, dynamic and workspace limits require site evidence

ownership.note: No verified acquire/release token; disconnect explicitly stops motion, so inspection is only for an idle robot with other clients exited

controlled_stop.value: RtMotionControl::stopMove; then read operationState and velocity
controlled_stop.note: Stop trajectory, duration and failure behavior must be verified; this release contains no hardware motion backend

watchdog.note: Packet-loss tolerance is not a validated watchdog timeout; do not change it

sdk_timeout.note: No bounded send/stop/connect timeout guarantee identified; parent timeout cannot establish physical stop
